newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan upbeat but concerned on stocks,inflation.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan upbeat but concerned on stocks,inflation.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan on Wednesday delivered an upbeat assessment of the U.S. economy but voiced concerns about soaring stock prices and the risk of higher inflation.
"Even I must admit that our economic prospects in general are quite favorable," the central bank chief said in his semiannual Humphrey-Hawkins economic testimony to Congress.
